newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.45 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.45 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 9.5 trillion lire 30-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.45 percent, compared with 7.79 percent at the previous repo tender on January 7, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.47 percent against 7.85 percent at the last repurchase pact for 12.5 trillion lire and eight days.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for resale on February 12. The Bank said it received 45 bids of which 16 were met in full and five in part.
